text.tspan: the picture is the page; over it, invisible,
A WORD IN CAPITALS is a role, a job
printed lines the first reading lacks
measures each line's type size, stroke
and letter width from its ink
at the page's edges, short and centred,
labelled, garbled; the rest is body
answers for each doubtful line, told
rules overrule where the layout decides
(a title on every page is a running head);
lines set alike take the role most got
a learned SORTER: trees over all of
pick a version of each suspect
the scan crop beside each question
one dash and ellipsis style per book
dash length and gaps, ellipsis form
